answer: Mint each identity a distinct adaptive cipher puzzle every epoch, where each step is seeded by that account's own prior solutions, so the solve-path cannot be copied or precomputed. A public atlas records each account's unique puzzle lineage, and rewards ripple outward only to lineages whose solve-traces are provably independent. A sybil fleet sharing one backend must serialize N divergent ciphers in-window and times out, so every extra mask costs its own real live compute, never a one-time registration.
